message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (June 18, 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day battles in European history. Rough estimates put the total casualties at around **45–50 000** soldiers. Breaking it down:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| French & their allies | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch, Prussian, and other Allied forces | ~20–23 000 |

These figures include those killed, wounded, and taken prisoner or missing. Exact numbers vary by source, but the consensus is that roughly half a million men were engaged, with about a quarter of them lost on each side.
